name: profile
title: Profile
description: A profile and settings screen: a turning avatar ring, stats that count up and grouped rows with switches.

perf.budget: The avatar ring turns on the UI thread. Stats count up for about a second after the screen opens (re-rendering on animation frames), then the screen is static.

measurements.notes: Animating at rest: the avatar ring keeps turning while the screen is open.

a11y.reducedMotion: The ring holds still, stats show their final values and blocks appear without settling in.
a11y.screenReader: The name and section titles are headers. Each stat reads as one value ("24.8k Followers"); rows are buttons with their detail as a hint, and switches are named after their row.
a11y.touchTarget: Rows are 56 pt tall; buttons and switches are at least 44 pt.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add profile`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
